summary: Pepco filed an 8-K reporting a bond purchase agreement and concurrent issuance of $300M aggregate principal of First Mortgage Bonds (three tranches: $110M 5.00% due 2036, $60M 5.30% due 2041, $130M 5.74% due 2056) sold to institutional investors under Section 4(a)(2). Proceeds are for debt repayment and general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation like an acquisition, restructuring, or capital return. No change of control, shareholder vote, or strategic event is triggered. No risk-arb angle; simply a straight debt issuance.
